title: Can ignition altitude/throttle strategy close the 88 kg gap?
goal: High-energy landing (2600 m ignition, 224 m/s) is infeasible: 3-engine burn needs 3238 kg vs 3150 kg available. Map where the feasibility boundary is before touching the guidance core.
acceptance: Sweep ignition altitude and initial throttle on the high-energy scenario; record min fuel or infeasible for every grid point in a CSV
A figure shows the feasibility boundary over the grid with the 3150 kg budget marked
The report states whether any point closes the gap, with the exact grid point and margin, or states clearly that none does in the tested range

research.hypothesis: Igniting later with a higher initial throttle (shorter burn, lower gravity loss) brings the 3-engine requirement under 3150 kg.
research.conditions: High-energy scenario only; 3-engine burn; vacuum SOCP planner; grid at least 8x8.
